mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates applied to future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 and industrial production (INDPRO) below 115 signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200 and INDPRO < 115 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 5%), a CPI rise above 208.5 signals inflationary pressures that prompt tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 5%), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 208.5 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A stronger labor market (higher PAYEMS) signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds the 50th percentile over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 380,000 signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 380000 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 4.7%) signals dual stress on monetary policy and labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and UNRATE > 4.7 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 115), reduced industrial output signals weakening corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 115 over a 3-year rolling window.
